role: Protocol-agnostic high-performance file transfer with structured output.

capabilities.name: get
capabilities.description: Download a file from a URL to local storage. Declares: mutates, destroys, network, loads_code.

capabilities.name: put
capabilities.description: Upload a local file to a remote URL. Declares: mutates, network.

capabilities.name: copy
capabilities.description: Copy files between any two locations (local or remote). Declares: mutates, network.

capabilities.name: head
capabilities.description: Inspect remote resource metadata without downloading. Declares: network.

capabilities.name: ls
capabilities.description: List contents of a remote or local directory. Declares: network.

capabilities.name: checksum
capabilities.description: Compute checksum of a local file. Declares: no effects.

capabilities.name: schema
capabilities.description: Output the full agentic ontology schema as JSON. Declares: no effects.

capabilities.name: capabilities
capabilities.description: List available protocols, operations, and features. Declares: no effects.

capabilities.name: serve
capabilities.description: Start an AFTP file server for high-performance binary transfers. Declares: network.

capabilities.name: crypto
capabilities.description: Quantum-resistant cryptographic operations (ML-KEM-1024 + AES-256-GCM, neural network cipher). Declares: mutates.

capabilities.name: telemetry
capabilities.description: Manage anonymous usage telemetry collection and reporting. Declares: mutates, network.

capabilities.name: sync
capabilities.description: Reconcile a directory tree against another, transferring only what differs. Declares: mutates, destroys, network.

capabilities.name: mv
capabilities.description: Move a file or directory. The source does not survive. Declares: mutates, destroys, network.

capabilities.name: rm
capabilities.description: Delete a file or directory. Declares: mutates, destroys, network.

capabilities.name: mkdir
capabilities.description: Create a directory. Declares: mutates, network.

capabilities.name: plugin
capabilities.description: Load or unload a protocol plugin. Declares: mutates, loads_code.

note: requires_grant is now DERIVED from the effects aft declares per operation -- mutates, destroys, network, loads_code -- and is true where an operation writes or loads code. An earlier version of this file said both fields were judgement, which was true when written; the tool now declares them. The ontology also covers all sixteen commands. It covered eleven, and the five it omitted included rm and mv, so an agent reading it as complete would have concluded aft cannot delete anything. Two tests now walk clap's parsed Command in both directions -- which immediately caught that the operations were named `move` and `remove` while the commands are `mv` and `rm`, an entry that would have looked correct and matched nothing. destroys is kept separate from mutates on purpose: writing a file and deleting one are both mutations, but only the second loses data the caller did not create. sync declares destroys because reconciling a tree removes entries absent from the source. loads_code is declared only by plugin, and is why plugin requires a grant despite touching no file the caller named -- it is the one operation that puts new executable code into the process. Budgets are judged and mark the operations whose cost scales with bytes moved or time served.
